howToUse.title: How to use Umbrella
howToUse.intro: Umbrella is a set of short, practical guides for people who need to think about their security — at work, at home, or on the move. The guides are written by trainers and practitioners who have used these techniques in the field.
howToUse.audience: If you are a journalist, activist, aid worker, diplomat, or business traveller in a high-risk environment, the app is designed for you. Everyone else is welcome too — the advice is generally good practice.
howToUse.footer: These screenshots come from the Umbrella Web build. They are intentionally faithful to what you see on the web — feeds, lessons, checklists, and forms — so you can match each step to the surface you'll actually use.

feeds.title: Feeds: a curated briefing
feeds.body: The Feeds tab keeps you current on risks in your area. Browse curated security advisories and incident reports without leaving Umbrella.

lessons.title: Lessons: structured learning
lessons.body: Work through topics in a guided order. Each lesson links to the underlying topic content, the relevant checklist, and the forms you can use in the field.

checklists.title: Checklists: track what you've done
checklists.body: Pathways are step-by-step checklists for situations where the order of decisions matters. Tick each step as you finish it; your progress is saved on this device.

forms.title: Forms: capture sensitive notes
forms.body: Fillable forms for incident response, travel, and proof of life. Your answers stay on this device until you export them to a printable HTML file you control.

credits.title: Photo credits
credits.intro: Every image on this site is a stock photograph from Pexels, used under the Pexels license (free for commercial use, no attribution required). We list the photographers here because the rest of this site is built on a promise of transparency — and a friendly credit is the right thing to do.
credits.thankYou: Thanks to the photographers above for sharing their work.

account.title: Account
account.headline: Your account page is on the way
account.body: Sign-in and sync already work — your pathways and forms are saved on this device and follow you across browsers once you sign in. A dedicated account page (where you can manage your devices, see what's synced, and revoke access) is planned for a future release.
